issues: The code does not handle the case when the input file is empty. — In the `analyze_text` function, it assumes that the text will always have some content. However, if the file is empty, this will cause an error.

The code does not handle non-UTF8 files correctly. — When opening the file in read mode with `encoding='utf-8'`, it will raise a `UnicodeDecodeError` if the file contains non-UTF8 characters. However, this error is caught by the general exception handler and only an error message is printed to stderr.

The code does not handle files that are too large to fit into memory. — In the `analyze_text` function, it reads the entire file into memory at once. If the file is very large, this will cause a `MemoryError`. However, this error is caught by the general exception handler and only an error message is printed to stderr.

The code does not handle files that are not regular files. — When opening the file in read mode with `open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8')`, it will raise a `FileNotFoundError` if the file does not exist. However, this error is caught by the general exception handler and only an error message is printed to stderr.

The code does not handle files that are not readable. — When opening the file in read mode with `open(filename, 'r', encoding='utf-8')`, it will raise a `PermissionError` if the file is not readable. However, this error is caught by the general exception handler and only an error message is printed to stderr.

The code does not handle invalid JSON output. — When calling `json.dump(result, sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=False, indent=4)`, it will raise a `TypeError` if the result is not a valid JSON object. However, this error is caught by the general exception handler and only an error message is printed to stderr.
